scope: Extend the shared staged raw MATERIAL inspector to mixed MATERIAL and DICTIONARY records, reusing the same bounded decoder and handle mapping.
evidence: The MATERIAL-only entry point retains its stricter name check and delegates to the shared mixed-object routine.

Generated ASCII and Binary graph controls inspect three remapped MATERIAL records and a DICTIONARY; a changed expected dictionary entry refuses atomically and the same writer succeeds after correction.
The owning sparse-material and compact-graph CTests passed; the raw-material test passed under AddressSanitizer with detect_leaks=0.

The utility validates selected output records only. The caller must supply the active OBJECTS view and separately establish source provenance, complete graph, HEADER/LAYER references and successful finalization.
remaining: Integrate staged OBJECTS, root dictionary, HEADER and LAYER checks in LibreCAD; preserve failure/retry and verify independent readback before enabling raw-only consumer replay.
